summary: ECARX Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with Arm to jointly explore and develop next-generation high-performance AI computing platforms for mobility and cross-industry physical-AI applications. The MoU covers joint co-engineering across system-level architecture, performance optimization, software enablement, functional safety, toolchain and cybersecurity validation, and ecosystem build-out, with tailored configurations for China and global markets. No financial terms, equity stakes, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are disclosed. The arrangement builds on prior collaboration via SiEngine's 7nm SE1000 and developing 5nm SE2000 SoCs. No special-situation event; watch for binding agreements or capital commitments.
